product: ORACOVER AIR LIGHT (code range 331-09x; adhesive-free film, hotmelt brushed on separately)
maker: LANITZ-PRENA Folien Factory GmbH, Leipzig, Germany (brands ORACOVER / Lanitz Aviation)
question: What colours does ORACOVER Air Light come in, with order numbers and areal mass per colour; do white, grey and black exist; can a gull livery (white underside/body, grey upper wing, black tips) be done in this film?
verdict: Yes, but only coloured variants exist: Air Light comes ONLY in coloured/metallised colours (light chrome = silver, light chrome red/yellow/violet/blue, and light scale white). The maker gives one mass for the whole product, approx. 18 g/m2 at approx. 12 um (oracover.de item pages show 18 for the chrome, chrome yellow, chrome blue and scale white items). The lanitz-aviation technical-data page lumps AIR INDOOR and AIR LIGHT together at 'ca. 17 g/m2', 12 um. There is NO clear variant of Air Light: the clear film is a different product, ORACOVER AIR INDOOR 'light transparent' 331-000 (approx. 17 g/m2). White exists (light scale white 331-099). No grey exists; the nearest is the silver 'light chrome' 331-090. No black exists in Air Light.

catalogue_entry_correction.problem: The entry merges two maker products. Per the maker's 2010 catalogue and current oracover.de item pages, AIR INDOOR (light transparent colours, 331-000..331-059, approx. 17 g/m2) and AIR LIGHT (light chrome colours + light scale white, 331-090..331-099, approx. 18 g/m2) are separate products. Both are approx. 12 um. A colourless (clear) render is only correct for AIR INDOOR 331-000 'light transparent'. No Air Light article is clear.
catalogue_entry_correction.mass_discrepancy: lanitz-aviation.com/sites2/7/technical-data-sheets gives 'ca. 17 g/m2' for 'AIR INDOOR and AIR LIGHT' together; the 2010 maker catalogue technical table gives INDOOR 'approx. 17' and LIGHT 'approx. 18'; oracover.de item pages (seen via search index only) give 'Weight in g/m2 · 18' for Air Light items. Recommend 18 g/m2 for Air Light colours and 17 g/m2 for Air Indoor, with the 17 g/m2 combined datasheet figure noted as the maker's rounded group value.

mass_by_colour_note: The maker does not give per-colour masses for AIR LIGHT; it publishes one product figure, approx. 18 g/m2 at approx. 12 um, in the 2010 catalogue technical table. Current oracover.de item pages show 18 for each colour where a weight field was visible (090, 094, 097, 099). The lanitz-aviation technical-data page gives 'ca. 17 g/m2' / 'Stärke: 12 µm' for AIR INDOOR and AIR LIGHT as one group. So the coloured/metallised Air Light variants weigh the same as each other (approx. 18), about 1 g/m2 above the clear AIR INDOOR (approx. 17). Contrast: standard ORACOVER and ORALIGHT opaque colours do vary by colour (e.g. Oralight opaque 42-48 g/m2 in the 2010 weight table).

upper_wing.status: substitute: a reflective silver chrome, not a matte grey. It reads as mirror-silver in strong light. No grey exists in Air Light.

wing_tips.status: black cannot be done in Air Light. Honest options: (a) leave the tips in light scale white or light chrome and drop the black tips; (b) use a sibling film for the tips only, ORACOVER AIR OUTDOOR 'matt design-black' 334-072-002 / -010 / -020 at approx. 33 g/m2, approx. 23 um (seen only through oracover.de search snippets; nearly twice Air Light's mass on the tip area). Same adhesive-free AIR system, so the same AIR hotmelt applies, but the black item is not independently verified.

livery_proposal.notes: A true white/grey/black gull livery cannot be done in ORACOVER Air Light. Within the film, the closest honest version is white (331-099) with a silver-chrome upper wing (331-090) and no black tips; every panel stays at approx. 18 g/m2. Adding black tips means bringing in a heavier sibling film (Air Outdoor matt design-black, approx. 33 g/m2) or paint (paint mass not researched). If renders must show grey rather than chrome, the honest label is 'light chrome (silver)'.

bom_lines_needed: Split the current entry 'film-oracover-air-light' into product-correct entries: 'film-oracover-air-indoor-clear' (331-000, approx. 17 g/m2, 12 um, clear) and one Air Light entry per colour used.

film-oracover-air-light-scale-white: 331-099-002/-010, 18 g/m2 (approx.), 12 um, colour light scale white, approx sRGB [240,240,236] (renderer approximation). BOM surfaces: wing lower surfaces, pod, tail.

film-oracover-air-light-chrome: 331-090-002/-010, 18 g/m2 (approx.), 12 um, silver metallic, approx sRGB [196,198,202] metallic (renderer approximation). BOM surfaces: wing upper surfaces (grey substitute).

Wing tips: either no separate line (tips folded into the white or chrome line), or, if black tips are kept, a sibling-film entry 'film-oracover-air-outdoor-matt-design-black' 334-072-002/-010/-020, approx. 33 g/m2, approx. 23 um. Mark it unverified until the oracover.de item page is read directly.

Area split per surface: wing area must be counted twice (upper chrome + lower white). Tail and pod area go on the white line. Mass = area x 18 g/m2 for Air Light lines, plus overlap allowance and brushed-on ORACOVER AIR hotmelt adhesive (0961, 100 ml; adhesive mass not researched).
Record the mass provenance on each line: 18 g/m2 is from the 2010 catalogue technical table and oracover.de item pages; the lanitz-aviation datasheet's 'ca. 17' is a grouped INDOOR+LIGHT value.
